text:
carmen: Hey folks — heads up: planning to work from Columbus, OH from 2026-04-20 -> 2026-07-19 (about 3 months). Quick Qs: 1) How will the monthly WFH stipend be handled/prorated? 2) Any PEO/payroll or state tax impact we should expect? 3) Do I need to formally change my homebase or just file a temporary remote form? 4) Can IT ship my laptop to the temporary address? Thanks!
maria (people-ops): Congrats on the trip! :tada: Short answers: 1) stipend is pro-rated by calendar days in the month — payroll will calc. 2) short stays usually don't create tax nexus but withholding might change; payroll will run an estimate. 3) submit the temporary remote form (don’t change permanent homebase unless you’re moving permanently). 4) IT can ship — they need a signed waiver. Please fill the two forms and tag us.
carmen: can you paste the links? i'll fill them now.
maria (people-ops): Sure — Homebase change vs temp remote: https://intra.redwood.com/peopleops/homebase-change (use only if permanent) and Temp Remote Request: https://intra.redwood.com/peopleops/temp-remote. For shipping: include exact address in the temp form and cc @alex (it).
carmen: Address block i'm submitting:
```
Name: Carmen Rivera
Temp address: 1234 High St Apt 2B
Columbus, OH 43215
Dates: 2026-04-20 -> 2026-07-19
```
Please confirm if that's enough.
payroll-bot: Payroll ticket created: PR-4821 — will estimate withholding delta and stipend proration. ETA 2 business days. (You will get an email thread with numbers.)
samir (legal): Quick legal note: Ohio taxes non-resident wages for work performed in-state; if Carmen remains a CO resident and this is <90 days, company-level nexus risk is low but withholding could still apply depending on payroll rules. Finance should confirm. @maria (people-ops) can loop in @finance if needed.
jess (eng-manager): Approved from my side for the temporary remote. Keep your calendar updated for any overlap with team on-call. :+1:
alex (it): We can ship. Need a signed equipment waiver and confirmation of someone to accept delivery. I'll queue RMA once waiver is signed. ETA shipping 3-5 business days after sign-off.
maria (people-ops): Thanks all — Carmen, once the temp form is in i'll: 1) ask payroll to finalize proration, 2) ask finance/legal to confirm tax withholding guidance, 3) instruct IT to ship after waiver. If anything urgent DM me.
carmen: Forms submitted and waiver signed. Thanks everyone! :heart:
payroll-bot: PR-4821 update: estimated stipend proration for May = $133.33 (pro-rated), estimated withholding change minimal. Laptop shipment RMA#7890 created. Closing ticket in 48h unless follow-up requested.
maria (people-ops): Noted — will follow up if finance needs more details. Safe travels and enjoy Columbus! :wave:
